elements.element: Cap limb (a): fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim
elements.evidence: "the charges paid by Customer to IBM for the Services in the twelve (12) months immediately preceding the accrual of the first claim" — paid-only, and anchored to the first claim
"up to the greater of $100,000 or the charges paid" — the floor remains $100,000, not USD 1,000,000

elements.element: Cap is mutual (applies to both parties)
elements.evidence: identical limb appears for IBM ("It is the cumulative maximum for which IBM and its Affiliates and Subcontractors are collectively responsible") and for Customer ("for which Customer and its Affiliates are collectively responsible")
"In no event will either party be liable to the other for special, incidental, or indirect damages or for any consequential damages (including lost profits or savings)"

elements.element: Uncapped carve-out for breach of confidentiality, data protection and security obligations
elements.evidence: "a party's breach of its confidentiality, data protection or security obligations" ... "the limitations and exclusions of liability in this Section 9 do not apply to Excluded Claims"

elements.element: Uncapped carve-out for gross negligence and wilful misconduct
elements.evidence: "a party's gross negligence, willful misconduct or fraud"

elements.element: Uncapped carve-out for infringement of the other party's IP
elements.evidence: "a party's infringement of the other party's intellectual property rights"

elements.element: Customer's payment obligations are not "damages" for cap purposes
elements.evidence: only "this Section 10 does not apply to Customer's failure to pay any amounts owing" — carves payment out of the consequential-damages exclusion, not out of the Section 9 cap

elements.element: Fallback: mutual cap of 12 months' fees
elements.evidence: greater of "$100,000 or the charges paid by Customer to IBM for the Services in the twelve (12) months", applied mutually

elements.element: Fallback carve-outs for indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct
elements.evidence: "a party's indemnification obligations under Section 8, a party's breach of its confidentiality ... gross negligence, willful misconduct"

reasons: Locked target was preferred, but the cap was left untouched: the fee limb is "charges paid" (not "fees paid or payable") and is anchored to "the accrual of the first claim" rather than the claim in question, and the floor remains $100,000 instead of USD 1,000,000. A short operator/number edit would have completed the preferred cap.

The preferred requirement that Customer's payment obligations are not "damages" for cap purposes is absent; the existing proviso only disapplies the Section 10 consequential-damages exclusion to non-payment, which does not address the Section 9 cap.

The inserted Excluded Claims clause is concise and correctly disapplies the Section 9 limits (including the records/data exclusion in 9.1(c)(2)) to all preferred carve-out categories on a mutual basis, so the carve-out element of the preferred position is satisfied.
Cross-reference gap to note: the mutual indirect/consequential exclusion sits in "Section 10", which the new clause does not disapply, so Excluded Claims remain subject to that exclusion.
Clause overall now sits at the fallback (mutual 12-month fee cap with the required carve-outs) and would not be redlined again, but the drafter's locked preferred level is not achieved.
